policy: relational module plus language LoRA, original base frozen
initialization: original pretrained weights and fresh LoRA, not PGM-adapted checkpoint

production.resume: automatic next segment restores module, LoRA, Adam, per-rank RNG and next unseen index
production.retention: last two complete checkpoints within each new output directory only
production.evaluation_gate: 240000 unique train questions and completed 1000-question validation

architecture.content_pool: fixed contiguous native-token-order bins; no object slot encoder
architecture.relation_attention: Q,K from content; V from learned symbols
architecture.native_path: preserved via residual; output projection zero initialized
architecture.joint_safety: input prefix only, excludes supplied answer; generation cache checked
architecture.dual_fusion: shared initial symbol bank; separate stream layers; concatenate and MLP-fuse symbols

limits: One seed per variant; exploratory screen, not statistical proof
Different insertion/fusion choices and parameter counts are confounded; no matched ordinary-attention control yet
PGM instruction is constant; this does not establish cross-modal generalization
No full-base fine-tuning or module-only production runs in this first group
Slurm queue delay unknown; production runs depend on passing real-weight GPU pilots
Partial coverage or partial test must never be reported as full 20%-coverage results
